summary: Six distinct Charlotte multifamily refinance opportunities qualify after applying the business rules and deduping one repeated entity (R6774 deduped to R1514). All six have active_confirmed loans, executed-note maturities inside the 2026-09-01 to 2027-08-31 window, a record owner verified since 2026-03-01, and a current Director of Finance verified since that date. Ranked by maturity ascending then original principal descending: R1514, R4598, R7567, R8446, R2663, R3927.
limitations: outstanding_balance_usd is null for every record; only original principal is supplied, so refinance sizing at maturity cannot be estimated from this packet.
Only one contact per property is provided; no backup decision-makers.
R8446 has no published email (null preserved); outreach requires an alternate channel.
Recorded-release update U-R4598-2 exists but is post-cutoff (2026-09-10); if the cutoff were extended, R4598 would drop out.
Unsigned draft U-R7567-3 is disregarded; if later executed, R7567's maturity could move to 2028-01-01 and out of the window.
Executed amendment U-R6902-1 was respected and removed R6902 from the window; no other extensions were flagged.
